turns.question: What was the net revenue in the week starting Monday 5 October 2026, as non-cancelled order amounts placed that week minus returns credited that same week, even when the returned orders were placed earlier?
turns.answer: Net revenue (revenue minus partner returns, finance's net sales) for the week 5 to 11 October 2026 was 190.0 EUR, with returns counted on the day they were recorded. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
